product.name: Payment Gateway
product.description: A licensed digital payment gateway that enables secure online payment processing and transaction tracking.

product.name: eCommerce Plugins
product.description: Software plugins that integrate SkipCash payment processing into e-commerce platforms for online transactions.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A service that generates payment URLs for merchants to send to customers for easy payment collection.

product.name: QR Code Payments
product.description: A payment method using QR codes to enable customers to pay merchants by scanning the code with their mobile devices.

product.name: Tap To Phone
product.description: A service that enables merchants to accept contactless card payments using their NFC-enabled smartphones without additional hardware.

product.name: Tap-to-Phone
product.description: A mobile point-of-sale tool that turns a smartphone into a card reader for accepting payments.
